grades: Entering grades 11 and 12 in Fall 2027 (or recent graduates)
name: Making a Game of It, AI Assisted (MGIT-AI) at Michigan State University
org: Michigan State University College of Engineering
what_you_do: A residential week learning to code, design and build your own video games, using AI as a coding and creative helper.
who_can_apply: Co-ed, open to U.S. and international students entering grades 11 and 12 in Fall 2027 with a GPA of 3.0 or better in engineering core courses. A transcript is required.
pay_detail: $1,299 program fee. MSU says it offers no scholarships for its pre-college programs.
deadline_text: Applications open mid-December 2026. Application deadline: July 9. The page does not print the year; it is the cycle for students entering grades 11 and 12 in Fall 2027.
how_to_apply: Online application with transcript. Payment by credit card is the last step and is required before review. If not accepted, the fee is refunded minus a $25 processing fee.
notes: Residential with dorm supervision. Contact: future-engineer@egr.msu.edu or 517-353-7282. Check the year of the dates against the application page when it opens.
